note: Three door moves, each decided by RoomData's door position. (1) PoD Compass Room SE is slotted Mid while its partner PoD Harmless Hellway NE is slotted Right; the door's Position.InteriorE puts it in the east half of 0x1a. (2) In 0x0b the small-key door PoD Lonely Turtle EN <-> PoD Dark Pegs WN (Position.InteriorN, the north half) and the trap door PoD Turtle Party ES <-> PoD Callback WS (Position.InteriorS, the south half) both fell on the (0,0)-(0,1) edge; the trap pair moves to the south half, where the Turtle Party's enemies are. (3) In 0x19/0x1a the small-key door PoD Dark Maze EN <-> PoD Falling Bridge WN (EastN/WestN, the north half) and the bomb wall PoD Dark Maze E <-> PoD Big Chest Balcony W (plain East/West, the middle) both fell on the (0,1)-(0,0) edge; the bomb pair moves to the south half, beside the Falling Bridge's bottom landing.
